crossRefs.note: But God raised him from the dead,
whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.

translations.web: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.
translations.bsb: But the One whom God raised from the dead did not see decay.
translations.kjv: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.
translations.asv: but he whom God raised up saw no corruption.
